detail_findings: CAD component: inspect local wall and detail dimensions; the band-only radial wall and ornament checks do not apply
limits: Release is sampled; features between rays can be missed
Sand-slot widths are a screening check, not a sand-strength model
Radial wall is not the minimum thickness in every direction
Channel volumes overlap at junctions and omit melt/handling losses
Separately cored geometry needs a core and assembly plan

notes: 115.49 mm² carries less than 0.0° draft, including bore walls; review drag and pattern finish
Sample spacing 0.100 × 0.100 mm; obstruction tolerance 0.020 mm. Features between samples may be missed. This checks rigid withdrawal, not sand strength or metal flow.

sampled_local_wall.note: Up to 384 surface-normal samples on the display mesh; small unsampled features and oblique walls require section inspection

setup.bench_notes: Investment cast the continuous half-turn ribbon. The changing section traps a rigid sand mold in a straight pull. Feed at the thick palm segment; preserve the twist when removing the sprue. Smooth and polish the uninterrupted ribbon, ease the bore edge, and verify the minimum measured bore after finishing. No separate overlapping bands or hidden assembly joints.

recipe.calibration_note: Uncalibrated starting allowance. Confirm with the caster's alloy, pattern material, mold, and measured trials.
